criteria.requirement: A twice-referenced definition produces one footnote with two backlinks; unused definition is omitted from rendered notes. Inline footnotes already exist and inline=False leaves the supplied inline notation literal. Choose explicit cited-output versus separate archival policy and document-local env rather than claiming all definitions are rendered or a missing inline feature.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
